name: Project Management (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Project Management capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: the Project Manager role, planning/risk work products, and the tasks for planning, coordinating, and monitoring the engineering effort.

capabilities.name: Project Management
capabilities.description: Plans, coordinates, and monitors the engineering effort, on behalf of the Project Manager role.

items.statement: A Project Plan exists covering scope, phases, and milestones.
An Iteration Plan exists with committed scope the team has agreed to.
Risks are identified, assessed, and have an owner and mitigation.

obligationDefinitions.title: The project risk list must be reviewed and refreshed on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: OpenUP's Project Management discipline maintains a risk list as a living artifact; a risk list last touched at project kickoff and never revisited stops reflecting the project's actual current exposure.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The risk list is reviewed and refreshed within the declared cadence, with stale risks retired and new ones added.

requiredEvidence.title: Risk list refresh record
requiredEvidence.description: Refreshed risk list with additions/retirements since the last review.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has the risk list been reviewed and refreshed within the required cadence?
